```yaml
name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
      - 'docs/spec/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Install Buck2
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/facebook/buck2/releases/download/2023.10.16.01/buck2-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu > buck2
          chmod +x buck2
          sudo mv buck2 /usr/local/bin/
          
      - name: Setup mdbook
        run: |
          mkdir -p mdbook-bin
          curl -L https://github.com/rust-lang/mdBook/releases/download/v0.4.35/mdbook-v0.4.35-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz -C mdbook-bin
          echo "$(pwd)/mdbook-bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          
      - name: Build mdbook-spec preprocessor
        run: |
          buck2 build //tools/mdbook-spec:mdbook-spec
          cp $(buck2 outputs //tools/mdbook-spec:mdbook-spec) mdbook-spec
          chmod +x mdbook-spec
          
      - name: Build website
        run: |
          cd website
          mdbook build
          
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./website/book
```
